name: @repo/s2-agent-ext-sv-analyzer
description: Pi extension: sv_analyze (design summary) + sv_ast (raw parse tree) for Verilog/SystemVerilog, powered by the same self-contained tree-sitter WASM (wasm32-wasip1) as the dsh-sv-analyzer DSH plugin — the Rust core in dsh-plugin/sv-analyzer/ is the single source of truth, and build.sh mirrors its wasm here.
